# Pure Rust naming regression inputs

Two original native graph inputs remain for regression tests of the clean
local Rust naming integration built on parser
[PR #291](https://github.com/Ameyanagi/ReShiki/pull/291):

| Retained input | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [ethanol-rust-native.rsk](ethanol-rust-native.rsk) | Neutral ethanol graph, C-C-O / C2H6O. |
| [r-lactic-rust-native.rsk](r-lactic-rust-native.rsk) | Specified R-lactic-acid graph, C3H6O3. |

The original caption save, accessibility snapshots, checkers, logs and
source/compiler/package/desktop receipts are preserved in the
[archived fixture package](https://github.com/Ameyanagi/ReShiki/tree/evidence/review-archive-2026-10/tests/fixtures/chemical-naming-rust).
Supplementary original JPEG captures are in the
[image archive](https://github.com/Ameyanagi/ReShiki/tree/evidence/review-archive-2026-10/docs/images/chemical-naming-rust).
Those historical records retain their original producers and coverage limits;
see the [native review](../../../docs/changes/rust-chemical-naming.md).
